Controls are not filtered by influence score. Accept a candidate only if both complete draws pass. Record every rejected candidate/pool witness. Stop if64 are not accepted before513th rejection or the positive ranking ends.
selection.cross_random_overlap: Allowed and reported. No duplicates within a group; no random unit overlaps the selected group.
